verdict.rationale: Algolia documents an official MCP server, listed in the docs navigation and confirmed by a probe. Its official agent-skills repo exposes search, analytics and recommendations through that server, plus index, settings, rules and synonym management via the CLI skill. Agent Studio also connects LLMs to Algolia search and tools. Missing for 10: in-depth MCP server docs (setup, tool list, auth scoping); explicit evidence that index write/config operations go through the MCP server rather than the CLI skill; independent or hands-on corroboration.
